questions.question: Explain how you would use a street guide's index and grid to find Mandela Street, Central, 47 D3.
questions.expected_answer: Look up Mandela Street in the alphabetical index, checking the suburb Central to choose the right street. Turn to page 47. Find column D along the top or bottom edge and row 3 along the side; where they cross is square D3. Scan that square for the street name.

questions.question: Give two differences between a street map grid reference and latitude and longitude.
questions.expected_answer: A grid reference names a square on one particular map and has no meaning on another map; latitude and longitude give a position on the whole Earth that works on every map and globe. A grid reference identifies a square (an area); latitude and longitude can identify a point in degrees. Grid references usually use a letter and a number; latitude and longitude use degrees with N/S and E/W.

questions.question: Give two advantages of map apps and two advantages of printed street maps.
questions.expected_answer: Map apps: show the user's position using GPS; search for places quickly; calculate routes and travel times; are updated often and may show live traffic. Printed maps: work without data, electricity or signal; show a large area at once to help plan a route and understand the layout; are not affected by app errors such as unsafe shortest routes.
